sermon.title: Are Deaths and Infirmities Caused by Sin? — May 30, 2021
sermon.speaker: Pastor David G. Kincer
sermon.summary: Continuing the signs in John, Pastor David G. Kincer asks who sinned when bad things happen: an accidental death, a child crushed by a piano, a pregnant woman hurt in violence, and God’s judgments. He says not every sickness or death is caused by sin, that God loves Christians who got sick and those who didn’t, and ends with David’s repentance and praise offering stopping the death angel.
